title: Finite machine decoded from a codeword
statement: For a natural number $k$, an effective coding scheme for machines with $k$ work tapes, and a finite Boolean word $\alpha$, the associated finite Turing machine has $k$ work tapes, state set $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$ where $n$ is the number assigned to $\alpha$ by the coding scheme, and underlying machine equal to the machine decoded from $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: The effective coding scheme has $k$ work tapes
